visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of a giant transparent bottle-shaped container filled with pink and white spheres; the brand logo 'KÉRASTASE PARIS' is printed on it. (2) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a pink knitted sweater, stands in a brightly lit room with a closet behind her, holding the giant bottle and smiling at the camera. (3) She holds a small, elegant round glass bottle containing a light orange liquid; she demonstrates the dropper mechanism, showing the clear oil dripping from the tip. (4) The woman points at her long hair, showing sections that look slightly frizzy and dry at the ends; she then applies the oil to her palms and runs them through her hair. (5) A split-screen comparison appears, showing her hair on the left side looking sleek and shiny after application, while the right side remains dry. (6) She opens several white and pink plastic spheres to reveal various plush keychains in the shape of stylized white clouds with pink bows and brand-related stickers. (7) She showcases a collection of these items including a pink hair tie and various small brand charms on a gold ring. (8) The video concludes with the woman holding a customized bottle decorated with pearls, posing in front of a shelf filled with skincare products and perfumes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-energy, fast-paced electronic pop track with a strong 4/4 beat. A male voiceover begins with an excited, high-pitched tone, speaking rapidly in Mandarin. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX plays as the camera cuts to the woman holding the giant bottle. The voiceover maintains high arousal. (3) A series of 'pop' and 'ting' sounds accompany the reveal of smaller items and stickers. The background music remains continuous and upbeat. (4) During the hair demonstration, the music continues but the voiceover becomes slightly more descriptive yet still energetic. (5) As the blind boxes are opened, playful cartoonish sound effects punctuate each reveal. (6) The video ends with a triumphant, energetic final sentence from the narrator over the swelling electronic beat.
